title: Assessing and Remedying Coverage for a Given Dataset
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on ensuring adequate data coverage for categorical attributes like race, sex, age, and marital status to prevent biased outcomes in algorithmic systems.
